detail.title: Intex FA90PGGL 9 Kg Fully Automatic Top Load Washing Machine (Plastic Body)
detail.overview: The Intex FA90PGGL 9 Kg Fully Automatic Top Load Washing Machine is designed to deliver powerful cleaning performance with maximum convenience. Equipped with 10 intelligent wash programs and advanced Fuzzy Logic Technology, it automatically optimizes water level, wash time, and washing parameters for superior fabric care. The large 9 Kg capacity makes it an ideal choice for medium to large families, while the 700 RPM spin speed helps remove excess moisture for faster drying. Its durable Stainless Steel Inner Drum ensures long-lasting performance and hygienic washing. Additional features such as Delay Wash, Low Water Pressure Operation, and End Program Buzzer enhance user convenience. Finished in an elegant Gray color, this washing machine combines modern design, energy-efficient operation, and reliable performance, backed by an 11-year motor warranty and 2-year comprehensive product warranty.
